text:
Maya: Heads-up — published the "Prompt Ideation" launch post + webinar replay link at 08:45. Want to run a 3-arm microexperiment for webinar registrants to improve first-success rate. Goal: +6pp lift in 14 days.

Jasper: Nice. Proposed arms:
1) 30 credits + in-app coach
2) templates-only + checklist
3) 0 credits + CTA to a 15-min office hours drop-in. Randomize by signup_id. Allocation ~33/33/34.

Rory: Quick baseline: first-success (first non-error generation) = 14.2% (last 7d). Events to track: `signup.source`, `credit_grant`, `prompt_use`, `generation.success`, `office_hours_rsvp`. Will add cohort filter tag `webinar_prompt_ideation_2026`.

Sana: Design question: modal vs inline tray? Modal gets attention but can feel blocking. Recommend a collapsible tray with a 2-step reveal for templates. I'll post Figma links in a bit.

Maya: Timing: prefer immediate grant for credits arm, but templates arm could be a 24h drip. Budget is tight so avoid too many timing variants.

Jasper: Copy plan (short):
- Welcome subject A: "Replay + Starter Pack: 30 credits inside"
- Welcome subject B: "10 templates to jumpstart your first prompt"
- Nudge subject: "Need ideas? Join our 15-min office hours"
I'll drop full copy by EOD.

Deploy Bot: Routing rule created: `route_webinar_prompt_ideation` -> `onboarding_flow_v2` (PR #842, staging).

Rory: Pre-launch QA checklist:
- cohort tag present on signup
- `credit_balance` increments on grant
- no duplicate grants (idempotency)
- sample 100 users to verify flow
I can run smoke at 11:30 and post results here.

Maya: Budget note: total credits cap 8,000. Per-user cap 50. Credit TTL 30d. Eng please enforce.

Sana: Modal/tray microcopy suggestion: "Kickstart your first prompt — 30 credits ready" with link to "10 starter templates". I'll attach assets.

Jasper: Email cadence: immediate welcome, 12h templates nudge, 3d office-hours invite. We'll split subject lines across arms for the AB test.

Maya: Owners: Jasper (copy + cadence), Rory (measurement + QA), Sana (design), Eng (routing + quotas). Target deploy: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Ping me on the final PR.

Deploy Bot: Job scheduled: `onboarding-route-deploy` -> 2026-03-24T02:00Z.

Maya: Thanks all — async check at 15:00 if any blockers. :rocket:
